Industries

Ensuring the flow
of critical data.

Industrial power cables, molded cables, and industrial wire harnesses produced in our manufacturing sites are installed and used all around the world.

Our approach

One supplier – from the cable to the finished system.

We build the systems for next-generation automated machinery – delivering the custom, zero-loss connectivity that industrial OEMs depend on for relentless throughput and absolute accuracy.

The full assembled industrial applications are manufactured in ARNIR with stringent quality control measures to ensure that every product we produce meets the highest standards of performance and durability.

Collaborating directly with automation builders and OEM test engineers from early prototyping through full-scale production, we optimize connector selection, conductor routing and strain relief to shorten manufacturing lead times and prevent field failure points.

What we build

Wiring, cabinets and integration.

  • Industrial power cables
  • Molded cables
  • Industrial wire harnesses and electrical looms
  • Cabinet wiring
  • Electro-mechanical integrations
  • Complete turnkey solutions and finished systems
Implementing resource management and effective planning in complex projects improves our ability to deliver on time.
